question: Two careful engineers implementing this rule independently, with only this contract, would produce DIFFERENT behavior on some input (the rule is ambiguous, under-specified, or relies on unstated host facts).

rules.text: need < 1 -> throws, whatever fulls holds. The message is not graded.
fullCount = the number of true entries in fulls.
hasQuorum is true iff fullCount >= need. need greater than the length of fulls never yields a quorum.
When hasQuorum is true, winnerIdx = the zero-based position of the FIRST true entry in fulls; otherwise winnerIdx = -1.
